_comment: Known, intentional CLI/Plugin differences consumed by scripts/check-parity.js (CC-365). Every entry needs a reason. The checker is a ratchet: an entry that stops being true is reported as stale so this file cannot silently rot. Do not add an entry to make a check pass without a decision recorded in PLAN.md.

independent_manifests.commander/cowork-plugin/mods/commander-h: HUD mod is versioned independently of the product (observe-only mod).
independent_manifests.dashboard/package.json: Separate app with its own release cadence.
independent_manifests.extensions/cloudcli/manifest.json: Cloud CLI extension manifest, own release cadence.
independent_manifests.extensions/vscode/package.json: VS Code extension, own release cadence.
independent_manifests.vscode-extension/package.json: VS Code extension, own release cadence.
independent_manifests.site/package.json: Marketing site package, not shipped with the product.

skills.cli_only_reason: The CLI ecosystem catalog under skills/ (467 skills per commander/contract.json) is a different surface from the Desktop plugin tree; CLAUDE.md states they are intentionally different.
skills.plugin_only_reason: Plugin skills in commander/cowork-plugin/skills/ are Desktop /ccc-* workflows and are not part of the CLI ecosystem catalog.

ccc-data.reason: Ships in the Desktop plugin as /ccc-data; CLI copy is a separate catalog variant, not merged.

external_script_registries.hooks/hooks.json: Kit overlay for installs that also have the ECC plugin; its scripts/hooks/* targets live in that external plugin, not in this repo.

context-guard.js.reason: Plugin copy is the maintained hook (ESM, UserPromptSubmit, transcript-based 70/85/95% thresholds, needs ../lib and ./lib). The CLI copy is a self-contained CJS PostToolUse call counter; install.sh copies hooks/*.js flat into ~/.claude/hooks with no lib/, so the plugin file cannot be dropped in or re-exported there.

pre-compact.js.reason: Plugin copy is the maintained hook (ESM, writes ~/.claude/commander/handoff-<session>.json, imports ../lib and ./suggest-ticker.js). The CLI copy is a self-contained CJS hook writing ~/.claude/sessions/pre-compact-*.md that tests/hooks.test.js covers; the flat standalone install cannot resolve the plugin imports.

registry_roles.hooks/hooks-standalone.json: CLI standalone installs (install.sh copies it to ~/.claude/hooks/hooks.json); runs hooks/*.js.
registry_roles.commander/cowork-plugin-codex/hooks.json: Generated from the plugin registry by scripts/build-codex.js; never hand-edited.
